issues.name: Data Bill of Rights
issues.question: Will you support a Data Bill of Rights giving people the right to access, move, delete, and receive a full accounting of their personal data, including prescription, grocery, food, product-purchase, loyalty-program, and other commercial data, and requiring data sellers to update a government ledger to receive safe harbor from liability?

issues.name: War-Crime Accountability
issues.question: Will you support a law requiring mandatory review, public reporting, and potential restrictions on U.S. weapons, funding, intelligence, or diplomatic support when credible evidence indicates that support may be connected to war crimes?

issues.name: Congressional Stock Trading Ban
issues.question: Will you support a ban on members of Congress, their spouses, and dependent family members trading individual stocks while in office?

issues.name: Citizens United Reform
issues.question: Will you support constitutional or statutory reforms to reduce the influence of unlimited outside spending, dark money, and Super PAC power after Citizens United?

issues.name: Universal Healthcare
issues.question: Will you support universal healthcare coverage so every person can access medically necessary care without financial ruin?

issues.name: US-Israel Military Merger
issues.question: Do you support the provision to merge U.S. and Israeli military command structures in the FY27 NDAA (Section 219 in the House bill, formerly Section 224), and why?
